turns.text: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!

Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?

Hey Dave, thanks for checking in! The insurance process was a hassle - it took forever and there was a ton of paperwork. But it's all sorted now, and I'm getting it fixed up. Can't wait to drive it again!
How long did it take to get everything sorted out? I'm glad it's all taken care of now!
It only took a week to sort everything out. I was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. Look at this photo from the auto repair shop.
Cool! Glad it wasn't too expensive. Who are him?
That's the mechanic. He knows the stuff and is doing his best to get my car running again.
That's great to hear! Skilled and knowledgeable people working on your car - are you feeling confident?
Feeling way more confident and excited to show off my car! Trusting their expertise.
Great, Cal! It's awesome when you trust the people fixing it. Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!
Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!
Wow, what an amazing view! Where is it? I haven't seen anything like that before!
Thanks, Dave! It's from a small town in Japan. The view of the mountains is unbelievably stunning!
Wow! Did you get to that place yet?
Nope, not yet! I haven't been there before, but it's on my to-do list for after my tour with Frank Ocean ends. Can't wait to see them in person! Look at that snowy peak.
Looks awesome! Have you ever tried skiing before? It looks like loads of fun!
Haven't tried it before, but it does look like a lot of fun! I might give it a try once. So what's up with you, is anything new in your daily routine?
Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys!
Playing guitar in a rock band is awesome, Dave! It will bring you a lot of emotions.
Sounds good, Calvin! Good company and great music, lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions! I have to go now. I'll see you soon!
Thanks, Dave! let's keep in touch, take care!

branches.label: Japan mountain view and future skiing
